menu_style.description: Step-by-step setup for operators who want recommendations.
menu_style.label: Guided Setup

fix_steps: Install Docker Desktop on Windows/macOS or Docker Engine on Linux.
Start Docker and wait until it reports that the engine is running.
Run the dry-run readiness check again before installing modules.
checks.message: Docker Desktop or Docker Engine is not available.
WSL 2 support is available for Docker Desktop on Windows.
Host resources are sufficient for the selected profile.
Ollama is available when local LLM features are selected.
Selected modules are compatible with their recorded CivicCore requirements.

readiness.next_action: Resolve blocker fix steps, then run readiness again.
